B_rmt.model: fixed-trace complex Wishart = reduced states of Haar states (random-matrix model)
B_rmt.mp_assumptions: d_A, d_B -> infinity with c = d_A/d_B fixed; x = d_A * lambda

models.haar: Haar-random pure state on N qubits
models.stabilizer: random 2-qubit-Clifford brickwork of depth 6N applied to |0..0> (converges to the uniform random stabilizer state; depths N,2N,4N,6N recorded as a convergence check)
models.brick_D: Haar 2-qubit-gate brickwork of depth D on an open chain, from |0..0>

D_stabilizer_exact.model: uniform random stabilizer states, complete enumeration (no sampling, no seed)
D_stabilizer_exact.prediction: Clifford orbit is a state 3-design => E Tr rho^k (k=2,3) equal Haar exactly; k=4 need not
